about: Release-policy template (W-42). release.sh policy sign fills policy_id, signed_at and expires_at, merges paths.json, and signs the result. allow names Tekton pipelines; anything not listed waits for the Owner. Every condition must hold for platform-api to approve a tier-C release without the Owner. Owner 10-08: no rolling cap; reminders 14d, 3d and 1d before expiry.
